stem: A shop in Kolkata sold 300 saris in 2023, and \(40\%\) of them were silk saris; the rest were cotton saris. In 2024, the number of silk saris sold was \(25\%\) greater than in 2023, and the number of cotton saris sold was \(10\%\) less than in 2023. By what percent did the total number of saris sold increase from 2023 to 2024?
verify:
s = Rational(40, 100) * 300
n = Rational(125, 100) * s + Rational(90, 100) * (300 - s)
assert n == 312
v = (n - 300) / 300 * 100
assert v == 4
assert len(spr_answers) == 1 and Rational(spr_answers[0]) == v
